propositions: REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY inline-PEM value is read into config but never removed from os.environ, remaining visible to child processes and environment dumps
Downstream processes spawned after config load (ssh-keygen via keyprov, git via workspace) inherit the unset environment variable without explicit env parameter
OpcertServiceConfig.from_env must consume the environment variable atomically by popping it after capture to prevent accidental leakage to child processes and debug endpoints
The consume-once semantics must be tested to prevent silent regression if a config reload path is added in future
Environment variable registry generation must preserve REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY in docs/env-vars.md when moving from os.environ.get to os.environ.pop pattern
